name: Soft sci-fi
one_line: Clean white curves, plants, and one orange accent.
look_words: A friendly future: white and pale grey rooms with rounded corners, soft even light, a few green plants and big windows. Surfaces are matte and smooth with thin panel lines; nothing is dirty or sharp. There is exactly one accent colour, orange, used for doors, handles, buttons and anything the player can use or should follow. A magenta-red means harm. The player is dark navy so it reads against all the white. Shadows are pale and soft. Motion is smooth and slow: sliding doors, a hovering helper, drifting dust in window light. Avoid neon, glowing blue lines, grime, dark corridors, lens flares and bloom.

palette.name: white station
palette.notes: One accent only: the second accent is the same orange, lighter. If everything is orange, nothing is. Text sits on the dark card.

look_wish: clean flat shading with thin outlines, or none

upgrade.why: its clean toon style gives flat fills and a tidy outline over an ordinary scene

music.mood: soft, airy synth pads and a gentle pulse

sound_feel: soft beeps, air hiss, smooth door slides, padded footsteps

frames.prompt: Soft clean science-fiction interior, third-person camera behind a small astronaut in a white suit with one orange stripe walking a curved white corridor with rounded panels, a big window onto a pale planet, potted plants, a little hovering helper robot. Matte white and pale grey surfaces, soft even light, a single orange accent on doors and handles, gentle shadows, calm and friendly, no glowing neon. Stylised simple 3D. Gameplay view of a stylised indie video game, no text, no user interface, no logos, no watermark.
